reviews.text: If I were the pet store owner, I'd be hesitant. The staff is extremely rude. We didn't take any photos or videos, but they didn't say hello to us and completely ignored us.
The sales staff was so rude. She didn't even care about my existence. (Discriminatory staff)
My pom LOVES the sweet potato treats I got here, now I regret I didn’t buy more than one package :(
Thank you for introducing me to Minu-chan; she's truly wonderful.
